description: Fetch a web page and get its main text as Markdown, with the title, word count, outgoing links, the final URL after redirects, and a SHA-256 of the Markdown. Before returning it, the page is judged: an app shell that needs JavaScript, a bot challenge, a cookie wall, a sign-in redirect or an error page comes back as verdict not_content with the reason, and does not count against your calls. Plain HTTP only: it does not run JavaScript.

api_key.description: Your key (sik_…), only if your MCP client cannot send it as the Authorization header, for example a key you just got from request_key. The header wins when both are sent.

name: fetch_page
title: Fetch a web page as clean Markdown
